blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Three of seven Filipino workers wounded in attacks in several areas of Saudi Arabia are in critical condition, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Monday, as Philippine authorities coordinate with Saudi officials to provide medical care and assistance. In a statement, the DFA said it and the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) were coordinating with Saudi authorities to ensure the injured Filipinos receive the necessary assistance. The Philippine government also extended its deepest condolences to the families of those killed in the attacks and wished the injured a speedy recovery.
